name: Chintz
summary: Cotton printed with large flowers and birds, often glazed, used for curtains, covers and walls.
how: Use one large floral repeat of 40 to 70 cm for curtains and covers.
Combine it with one stripe or check in a colour of the flowers.
Repeat the same print on 2 to 3 pieces in the room.

origin.note: Painted and printed Indian cottons reach Europe through the East India Companies.

adoptions.via: Victorian parlours cover sofas, curtains and walls in floral chintz.
Roller-printed cotton in strong floral patterns covers sofas, chairs and curtains in factory-made sets.
Grandmillennial rooms bring back chintz, skirted tables and floral wallpaper.

sources.title: Rosemary Crill, Chintz: Indian Textiles for the West (2008)
